Class InPlaceReplicationConfig

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.composum.sling.core.AbstractSlingBean
      • com.composum.sling.platform.staging.replication.AbstractReplicationConfig

    Direct Known Subclasses:
    InPlaceReplicationConfig.ImplicitInPlaceReplicationConfig
    public class InPlaceReplicationConfig
extends AbstractReplicationConfig
